snippet.title: Classic Space Adventure - A LEGO® Fanmade Game
snippet.description:
Classic Space Adventure is a LEGO® fanmade game by Johan Alexanderson. It is free to play in a web browser (Chrome is recommended). You need a keyboard in order to play the game.  Play the game on this link -  http://jalex.se/classicspaceadventure/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/classicspaceadventure
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/legobyjalex/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/LegoJalex
